events.title: 앤디 웹스터 's controversial move to 위건 애슬레틱 is ratified by FIFA .
리버풀 get permission from 리버풀 city council to build a new 60,000 all-seater stadium in nearby Stanley Park .
Recopa Sudamericana 2006 return match, 보카 주니어스 wins its 16th international title against São Paulo , breaking the world record on number of international club titles.
브라이언 롭슨 is sacked after less than two years as manager of 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 .

After becoming majority shareholder at the club, Randy Lerner officially becomes chairman of 애스턴 빌라 , replacing 82-year-old Doug Ellis . A BBC Panorama programme is aired, alleging widespread corruption in the English game.

September ends with reigning champions 첼시 top of the Premiership. 볼턴 원더러스 are keeping up their push for a European place, being only two points behind in second place. 맨체스터 유나이티드, 포츠머스, 에버턴, 애스턴 빌라 and 아스널 complete the top seven, with 토트넘 홋스퍼, 왓퍼드 and 찰턴 애슬레틱 in the relegation zone. Cardiff have extended their lead in the Championship to five points, ahead of Birmingham. 프레스턴 노스 엔드, 크리스털 팰리스, 사우샘프턴 and 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 stand in the play-off places and 사우스엔드 유나이티드, 헐 시티 and 셰필드 웬즈데이 in the relegation zone. 노팅엄 포리스트 continue to lead League One, with a three point cushion over their nearest challenges 요빌 타운 and 브리스틀 시티, with 요빌 타운 above 브리스틀 시티 on goal difference. Bradford, Tranmere and Carlisle in the play-off places, with Scunthorpe a point behind, recovering from their slow start. Rotherham, 레이턴 오리엔트, 밀월 and 블랙풀 in the bottom four. 월솔 lead League Two, with Swindon and Wycombe completing the automatic promotion places. Lincoln, 밀턴킨스 던스, 노츠 카운티 and Hartlepool complete the top seven. 매클즈필드 타운 and Boston United in the drop zone.
